info.title: RMA Procedure
info.subtitle: Return and repair procedure for Osec products
info.procedureStep1: To return products to Osec, please fill out a Repair / Return Form in advance via the 'Go to RMAs' button below. You will not receive a separate receipt confirmation for your submitted form — your submissions will appear in your RMA section.
info.procedureStep2: Upon receipt of your shipment at our warehouse, you will receive a delivery confirmation. Osec aims to process all RMA requests within 14 working days.
info.procedureStep3: Please include a printed copy of the RMA form inside the box and attach the barcode label to the outside of the package.
info.loginToSubmit: Log in to submit an RMA
info.warrantyText1: If investigation reveals that defects are the result of improper use or fall outside warranty conditions, the product will not be replaced or refunded.
info.warrantyText2: After consultation, items are either returned at the customer's expense or forfeited.
info.warrantyText3: Osec reserves the right to return items submitted without a properly completed RMA form, without further explanation.
info.returnCondition1: Products must be unused, undamaged, and complete
info.returnCondition2: Original packaging must be undamaged and unopened
info.returnCondition3: Returns are accepted within 60 days of the invoice date
info.returnCondition4: A €15 reset fee per product applies if the product has been configured — please reset to factory settings before returning
info.resetIntro: Before returning a product, please reset it to factory settings to avoid the €15 reset fee. See the instructions below for common brands:
info.contactSubtitle: Our RMA team is happy to help you with the status of your return or any question about the procedure.
info.stat2Label: days return window for unused products

create.subtitle: Create a new return request
create.notFound: Can't find your product? Send an email to
create.thankYou: Thank you for creating your return order!
create.confirmationLine1: We will start processing your RMA request as soon as the RMA package has arrived in Purmerend. If you need a replacement product sooner, you can order it yourself.
create.confirmationLine2: You can view the current status of your RMA via the RMA dashboard.
create.confirmationLine3: Should you have any questions in the meantime, please do not hesitate to contact us.
create.confirmationThanks: Thank you in advance for your cooperation!
create.shippingTips: General tips to process your RMA as quickly as possible:
create.tip1: Only unused and complete items are eligible for credit. Do not forget to include accessories such as cables, power supply, or screws. Ensure that the items are in the correct, undamaged packaging.
create.tip2: If a product is incomplete or shows signs of assembly, we reserve the right to credit the product for 90%, 70%, or 50%.
create.tip3: Are you unsure whether a product qualifies for credit? Send an email to rma{'@'}osec.nl or call us on 0299 66 66 62 option 4.
create.tip4: Set a product to factory default and return it without a password; if, after verification, it turns out that the product is configured, we will charge a €15 reset fee, per product bill.
create.tip5: Also consider unlinking products that are linked to an app.
create.tip6: Defective products must be returned complete. That is, including power supply and/or housing.
create.tip7: Defective products must be repaired by default or password protected {password} or to be guided by the admin password/service code.
create.tip8: If necessary, we can use this to create as realistic a test setup as possible and offer you a suitable solution as soon as possible.
create.reviewNote: Please verify the information below is correct before submitting. You can still delete items if needed.
create.returnConditionWrongOrder: Unused, undamaged, complete in original packaging within 60 days
create.returnConditionDefect: Warranty conditions apply — see warranty indication
create.returnConditionLoan: Return within 30 days in new condition for full credit
